title: Add two numbers
description:
Read two whole numbers and print their sum in this form:

```
3 + 7 = 10
```
hints: You can read two values in one statement: `std::cin >> a >> b;` The user may separate them with a space or by pressing Enter.
Mix text and values in one print statement. The spaces around `+` and `=` are inside the quoted strings: `" + "` and `" = "`.
